mapper.select:
SELECT ${resource.idColumn} AS id, name,
${resource.statusColumn} AS status, NULL AS status,
updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ${resource.tableName} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
AND name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE ${resource.tableName} SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE ${resource.idColumn} = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_role_assignment WHERE role_id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_role_assignment WHERE local_user_account_id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu_permission WHERE menu_id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu WHERE parent_menu_id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM detail_code WHERE code_group_id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO change_history (change_history_id, target_table, target_id, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), #{targetTable}, #{targetId}, CAST(#{beforeValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{afterValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{changedBy}, #{changeReason})

INSERT INTO mapping_transaction_lock_constraints ( mapping_transaction_lock_constraint_id, target_table, target_id, operation_type, mapper_technology, transaction_status, korus_snapshot_read_only, locked_by, locked_at, released_at ) VALUES ( gen_random_uuid(), #{targetTable}, #{targetId}, #{operationType}, 'MYBATIS_BLOCKING', 'COMMITTED', TRUE, #{lockedBy}, NOW(), NOW() )
